name: Solax Battery
tagline: Stackable high-voltage LFP battery, from 7.37 kWh to 47.92 kWh.
summary: The Solax T-BAT-SYS-HV-S3.6 is a high-voltage battery system built from stackable 3.6 kWh LFP modules, from two modules up to thirteen.
It is rated IP65 for indoor or outdoor floor mounting, and battery heating keeps it working at low temperatures.

highlights.title: Remote management
highlights.text: Faults can be diagnosed and the battery upgraded and maintained remotely.

highlights.title: Battery heating
highlights.text: Built-in heating technology supports operation at low temperatures.

highlights.title: Reliable LFP cells
highlights.text: LFP battery cells with high-performance processors and soft-start surge protection.

highlights.title: IP65 protection
highlights.text: Rated IP65 for indoor or outdoor installation.

highlights.title: Extendable capacity
highlights.text: Stackable plug-and-play modules let you add capacity over time.
